text: we have multi-peice select but we also use to have and need to re-add select all connected pieces inside of the world editor
resolution: Re-added 'select all connected pieces' to the world editor loader pane (LoaderIsoView). The deleted IsoAuthor (req_1967) had a smart-select reach that grabbed a click's whole connected structure; in the loader pane that only survived as double-click whole-object select (one structure from a bare click). Added a G keybinding + selectConnectedToSelection() that grows the CURRENT selection — including a multi-picked set of loose pieces from Ctrl-click — out to every transitively-touching piece, unioning GAME_BUILD.placed.connected per seed (the same connectivity walk double-click already uses). No-op when nothing is selected or nothing new would be added. Bound in the existing key bus alongside R/C/Del, matching the loader pane's keyboard-verb pattern. Verified with a clean SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 build of hmsc-int.
